text:
kate: Kicking off deploy for payments-service v2.3.4. Planning to ramp the new risk_check_v2 feature flag during the weekend maintenance window (Sat 02:00-06:00 UTC). Posting ramp plan, rollback criteria, and quick kill instructions below. Ping if any objections.

devin: SGTM. What's the ramp cadence?

kate: Plan: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Intervals: 20m between steps, extra 30m hold at 25% for smoke checks. Metrics to watch: error-rate (service), payment-failures, P95 latency, and SLO traces flagged by tracing-alerts.

release-bot: deploy request received: `deploy payments-service:v2.3.4 --env=prod --window=2026-10-18T02:00:00Z/2026-10-18T06:00:00Z`

ops-bot: Monitoring links: 
- Grafana dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/payments-service
- Traces: https://jaeger.redwood.local/search?service=payments-service

sami: DB migration? Any schema changes that require a coordinated rollout?

kate: No schema changes. This is pure inference and validation layer change. Canary instances use same DB.

jun: Agree with cadence. Add a pre-rollout smoke that runs a subset of real-world test traffic against canary at 1% before increasing. Also recommend pinning the canary to the exact image digest so we don't accidentally move.

kate: Yes pinned to digest: `sha256:3a5b...c9f2`. Smoke job will run at t=+5m after 1% ramp.

devin: What's the rollback criteria? Auto-rollback or manual?

kate: Rollback criteria (any of the following during a step):
- service error-rate > baseline + 1.0 percentage point for 2 consecutive 1m windows
- payment failure rate > 0.5% absolute increase
- P95 latency > baseline * 2 for 2 consecutive 1m windows
- Any 5xx surge > 50 requests/min above baseline
Manual rollback by default. Release-bot will post alerts and we can flip flag to disable if needed. We can enable auto-kill if on-call wants it enabled (requires ops approval).

jun: Can you paste the toggle runbook? Need an instant kill if dashboards blow up.

kate: Quick toggle (run from infra box):
```bash
# disable risk_check_v2 globally
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://flags.redwood.local/api/v1/toggles/risk_check_v2/disable

# re-enable
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://flags.redwood.local/api/v1/toggles/risk_check_v2/enable
```
Also UI link: https://flags.redwood.local/risk_check_v2 (ops role required).

devin: Can release-bot run a smoke check and pause if smoke fails? That would avoid manual watching for the first step.

release-bot: I can run the smoke job and pause rollout on failure. To enable, add `--auto-pause-on-smoke-fail=true` to the deploy command. Otherwise I will only alert.

kate: Let's enable auto-pause for the 1%->5% step only. We'll keep manual beyond that. I'll update the rollout command.

kate: Final deploy command I'm kicking off in 5m: 
```
deploy payments-service:v2.3.4 \
  --env=prod \
  --digests=sha256:3a5b...c9f2 \
  --window=2026-10-18T02:00:00Z/2026-10-18T06:00:00Z \
  --ramp-steps="1,5,25,100" \
  --step-intervals="20m,20m,30m" \
  --auto-pause-on-smoke-fail=true
```

ops-bot: Noted. Pager schedule for this window: //oncall/payments-team -> jun (primary), sami (secondary).

devin: I'll be on standby too. :thumbsup:

sami: leaving a bookmark for rollback notes in case we need postmortem: https://wiki.redwood.local/rollbacks/payments-v2.3.4

release-bot: Deploy started at 2026-10-18T02:00:00Z. Canary (1%) applied to instances: payments-canary-1..3. Smoke job running.

ci-bot: Smoke job result: FAILED - 2/10 test transactions returned 502 at t+6m.

release-bot: Auto-pause triggered (smoke failed). Rollout paused at 1%. Notifying on-call.

jun: Investigating logs now. Pulling recent traces.

kate: OK pausing is expected. Do not escalate yet until we see root cause. If failure correlates to risk_check_v2, we'll flip flag off.

devin: I see in logs the risk-check service returned 502 for certain BIN ranges. Could be an upstream validation timeouts.

kate: I'm toggling flag to disable for canary only so we can continue other infra changes: `curl .../toggles/risk_check_v2/disable?scope=canary`.

release-bot: Toggle acknowledged. Canary instances reverted to baseline. Rollout remains paused.

kate: Good catch team. We'll fix the upstream validation and re-run smoke tomorrow. Leaving rollout paused and will file a follow-up. :white_check_mark:
